releases.title: Quiet sound styles
new: Choose Felt click, Walnut tap, Bamboo ticks, Tiny gears, or Crystal whisper in the editor's Sound style settings. Crystal whisper is the default style.
Preview a sound before using it. Your selected style is saved and included when you save a portable test document.
improved: A soft press sound follows the center press. Opening plays when you release, and closing plays with the reverse animation in both radial and docked mode.
Button and parent-menu sounds use the selected subtle style. Your existing Sound on or off preference is preserved; Preview does not change it.

releases.title: Live Glass and a faster press-to-release menu
improved: Press and hold the floating center with your pen, finger, or mouse to gently expand it. The settings ripple and bronze fill begin when you release. Dragging still moves the menu without opening settings.
The released radial animation now takes 420 ms instead of 960 ms. Docked settings fill in 360 ms instead of 760 ms. Closing still reverses the animation.
fixed: Glass stays visible through the center press, settings animation, docking and undocking, and center dragging. The blur follows the visible menu rather than the temporary input area.
Moving Glass reuses its shape when possible, while animated fragment coverage keeps blur processing bounded. Glass off and Reduced motion are still respected.

releases.title: Press and release ripple and aligned docking
improved: Opening the floating radial's center menu now uses the selected Press and release animation: the center grows and pauses, then the outer buttons move gently outward as bronze spreads through them.
The transition takes 960 ms, with up to about 8% center expansion and 6 pixels of outward movement. Closing reverses the motion, including when you change direction partway through.
The docked rail keeps its contained liquid fill. Reduced motion skips the ripple.
fixed: The docking animation's guide now follows the finished rail's position and rounded edge. The rail fades in around the landing icons, removing the misaligned reveal.
Docking and undocking share the same landing layout, including menus with empty button slots and different display scales.

releases.title: Sharper menu text and icons
fixed: Menu icons and labels now render at your display's pixel density instead of enlarging low-resolution artwork. This applies to the radial, child menus, settings menu, and dock.
Artwork refreshes when the display scale changes while retaining the smooth-drag cache.
improved: Small radial labels are slightly larger for easier reading without increasing the menu size.

releases.title: Children in place and smoother dragging
improved: In the floating radial, tap a parent or slide outward from it to replace the current ring with its children. Nested parents use the same center, and tapping the center goes Back. Lifting the opening contact leaves the children ready for your next tap.
Drag the center to move the floating radial, including an open child menu. The dock keeps its existing slide-out fan and hold-at-pen behavior.
fixed: Dragging reuses the menu artwork and keeps pointer capture stable to reduce lag and glitches. Glass returns when the drag ends instead of being rebuilt at every movement.

releases.title: Install updates in one click
improved: After downloading an update, click Install update. Radial closes safely, installs the verified update, and reopens automatically without extra installer or Open now prompts.
Updates started from this version reopen in the same docked, radial, or editor mode. A progress window shows when Radial is closing, installing, and reopening.
Saved menus and settings are preserved. Unapplied editor changes still offer Apply, Discard, or Keep editing before the update starts. Failed installer launches leave Radial open so you can retry.

releases.title: Animated switches between dock and radial
fixed: Switching between the docked rail and floating radial now plays the transition every time, including repeated long presses of the pen side button and the Dock / Radial settings controls.
Reversing a mode change while it is moving continues smoothly from its current position. Reduced motion still switches immediately.

releases.title: Hold to switch modes and show child menus
improved: Hold your selected pen side button for half a second to switch between the docked rail and floating radial. Release after a quick press to open or hide the menu. Releasing a long press leaves the switched menu visible.

Hold a parent button for 300 ms to show its child radial at the pen tip. The docked rail and its buttons stay visible alongside it. Release the parent to close its children; choose a child with the pen while the parent is still held.

A child that was already selected keeps its action or modifier behavior when the parent is released. Sliding outward from a parent still opens its fan. Pen settings explain the short-press and long-press controls.

releases.title: Pen trigger, hover locks and automatic closing
improved: The editor now has a visible Pen trigger row. Barrel button is the default; choose Invert / second button or turn pen-button triggering off. Changes save automatically.
Pen settings uses the same clear button names and remains available for live pen diagnostics. Ctrl+Alt+Space continues to open or hide the radial menu.
Dragging out from a modifier locks it on until the pen leaves hover range. Lifting the tip or the selecting finger keeps that lock active. Tapping a floating modifier still arms one pen stroke.

Choosing an action or modifier automatically closes the floating radial while preserving the selected modifier's hold. The docked rail stays visible, and selecting a child closes its menu. Explicit Hide, the trigger shortcut, editing, target changes and exit still release held modifiers.

releases.title: Pen lift and hover tracking
fixed: Floating modifier buttons now use pen-tip events from the Tablet Pro pen DLL as well as Windows. The modifier stays held through the next drawing stroke and releases when the tip lifts, while ignoring the lift used to select the modifier.
The main radial opens at the latest pen position. Hover tracking now also reads integrated and external pen reports and maps them to the correct display.
improved: Integrated and external pens have separate listeners. Full pen packets retain pressure, tilt, hover, tip, barrel, invert and eraser states.
Pen settings show live listener status and tip-down/up counts. Disconnecting a tracked pen or losing a pen listener releases held modifiers.

releases.title: Slide for a fan, hold for a radial
improved: Sliding out of a parent button opens its children in the familiar fan shape. Slide over a child and lift to choose it; lifting in the neutral area cancels.
Holding a parent for 300 milliseconds still opens a full circular menu at the latest pen-tip position. This works in radial and docked mode, including nested parents.

releases.title: Build parent menus by dragging
new: Drag a button onto a parent in the editor's menu list to move it into that parent's next empty child slot. Choose Arrange buttons to do the same in the radial or docked preview.
Hold a parent for 300 milliseconds to open its child radial at the latest pen-tip position, or slide out to open it at your finger. Existing parents support both gestures in radial and docked mode.
Add parent, Add child, and Make parent simplify menu creation. Make parent keeps the original action as its first child.
improved: Green drop feedback identifies a valid parent. The list scrolls as you drag near its edge. Esc cancels a drag, and Undo restores the previous layout.
Moving a parent keeps its entire child tree. Full parents, loops, and moves beyond four parent levels are blocked without replacing buttons. Changes remain a draft until Apply.
The pen can select a child while the launching finger stays down. The original menu steps aside while the child radial is open; its center goes back through nested menus.

releases.title: Parent menus at your pen or finger
new: Hold a parent button for 300 milliseconds to open its child radial at the latest pen-tip position. Slide out to open it at your finger instead, then release over a child or lift in the center and tap one.
The editor now has Add parent, Add child, and Make parent. Make parent keeps the original action as the first child, and named child slots make editing easier.
improved: Existing parent buttons use the same gestures in radial and docked mode. The center goes back through nested menus; Esc closes them.
Pen and finger input are tracked separately, allowing the pen to choose a child while the launching finger stays down.
The original menu steps aside while its child radial is open. Child modifiers use the floating menu's next-pen-stroke behavior.

releases.title: Neater rail highlights
fixed: On, hover, and pressed highlights stay inside the docked settings rail, keeping its outer border visible. Button targets and on-state indicators stay the same.

releases.title: Softer Glass and easier pen control
new: Drag anywhere inside the radial's center circle to move it. Tap the centered ellipsis to open settings.
In floating radial mode, tap Alt, Ctrl, or Shift to hold it for your next pen stroke. Lifting the pen after that stroke releases it; tap the modifier again to cancel.
improved: Closing settings reverses Gentle bloom toward the ellipsis in both radial and docked mode. Closing or reopening midway continues from the current animation frame.
Glass fades outward by one quarter of the menu body's width: about 11 pixels around the dock and 51 pixels around the radial. The clickable area stays the same.
Hiding the menu or pressing its pen button or shortcut releases held modifiers. Docked hold, drag, and double-tap controls are retained.
fixed: Removed the rectangular hover highlight from the radial center. Its tooltip sits fully above the outer edge, or below the whole wheel near the screen top, keeping every button clear.
Inset the dock's top corners to prevent edge clipping.
Rebuild the menu's graphics, clipping, and Glass surface after display layout, scaling, or compositor changes.

releases.title: Softer Glass and easier pen control
new: Drag anywhere inside the radial's center circle to move it. Tap the centered ellipsis to open settings.
In floating radial mode, tap Alt, Ctrl, or Shift to hold it for your next pen stroke. Lifting the pen after that stroke releases it; tap the modifier again to cancel.
improved: Closing settings reverses Gentle bloom toward the ellipsis in both radial and docked mode. Closing or reopening midway continues from the current animation frame.
Glass fades outward by one quarter of the menu body's width: about 11 pixels around the dock and 51 pixels around the radial. The clickable area stays the same.
Hiding the menu or pressing its pen button or shortcut releases held modifiers. Docked hold, drag, and double-tap controls are retained.
fixed: Removed the rectangular hover highlight from the radial center and kept tooltips above the menu and inside the screen edges.
Inset the dock's top corners to prevent edge clipping.
Rebuild the menu's graphics, clipping, and Glass surface after display layout, scaling, or compositor changes.

releases.title: See what's new when an update opens
new: A What's new window opens automatically the first time you run a newly installed version.
Read that version's additions, improvements, and fixes immediately, even when offline.
improved: The welcome appears once per version on this Windows account, whether you start in radial, docked, or editor mode.
Choose Let's go to continue, or View update log to browse the full version history.

releases.title: See what changed in every update
new: An in-app update log lists changes by version, with the installed version clearly marked.
Open Update log from the tray, the editor's bottom bar, or the Updates window.
Read the included version history even without an internet connection.
improved: New, improved, and fixed items are grouped so changes are easy to scan.

releases.title: A new logo across Windows
new: The bronze-and-ivory fan logo appears in the taskbar, Start menu, system tray, app, and installer.
improved: The logo includes sizes for small tray icons and larger Windows shortcuts.
The tray keeps its update-available badge.

releases.title: Gentle bloom opens settings
new: Tap the ellipsis to fill settings with bronze, like liquid spreading into the menu.
The bloom spreads from the radial center or downward through the docked rail, revealing ivory icons.
improved: The 760 ms animation stays within the existing menu outline; the dock remains 44 px wide.
Back or hide cancels the fill immediately. Reduced motion switches instantly.
Drawing actions pause during the fill, and settings become interactive when it finishes.

releases.title: Modifier buttons and easier editing
new: The default menu includes labeled Alt, Ctrl, and Shift buttons.
Hold a modifier to activate it. Drag out to keep it held for the current contact, then lift to release. Double-tap to keep it on until the next tap.
Choose Menu → Edit, then tap a button to open its inspector. Right-click also opens direct editing.
The radial's outer ring can switch to Dock, Edit, Sound, Glass, Hide, and Quit.
improved: Held modifiers release when hiding the menu, opening the editor, changing target apps, or quitting.
Customized menus are preserved. Unchanged old defaults upgrade automatically; other profiles can use the undoable Use new default menu action.

releases.title: The Continuous rail
new: One slim 44 px housing holds the docked tools and settings.
The top ellipsis switches to bronze settings with ivory icons inside the same rail. Back restores the drawing tools.
improved: Settings keep full-size pointer targets without opening a side panel.
Sound and Glass show a visible indicator when enabled.
Input and Glass boundaries follow the rail's narrow outline.

releases.title: Download and update from GitHub
new: The official GitHub update feed is preconfigured for Tablet Pro Radial.
Use Updates in the tray or editor to check, download, and install a newer release. Automatic checks can notify you when one is available.
improved: Downloads are verified before installation.
The installer includes the runtime, matching source, and third-party notices while keeping saved menus and preferences.
